faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Dredger Commander post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Dredger Commander post at Cochin Port Authority is 12th October 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Dredger Commander position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Dredger Commander position is 64 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Dredger Commander role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Dredger Commander role ranges from Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 1,40,000 per month, depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Dredger Commander post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Dredger Commander post on a contract basis at Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Dredger Commander post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Certificate of Competency as Master Foreign Going with Chief Officer experience, or Dredger Master Gr I with 2 years experience, or Master NCV with 2 years experience, or relevant Indian Navy experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on eligibility, followed by a personal interview (15%) and evaluation of qualifications and experience (85%), and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Dredger Commander position?
faq.answer: The Dredger Commander position is on a contract basis with Cochin Port Authority.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and apply online through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Cochin, Kerala, with the pincode 682009.
